gloss: double-talk; duplicity; speaking with a forked tongue

definitions.gloss: double-talk; duplicity; speaking with a forked tongue
definitions.explanation: Saying contradictory things to different people, or contradicting one's own earlier words; deceitful, two-faced speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二枚舌|にまいじた}だ。
{二枚舌|にまいじた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust someone who talks out of both sides of their mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧{二枚舌|にまいじた}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was angry at his two-faced way of changing what he said depending on the listener.

notes:
Literally 'two tongues.' Almost always used with ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ in the set phrase {二枚舌|にまいじた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to engage in double-talk).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二枚舌|にまいじた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to say two different things; to be deceitful

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏表|うらおもて}→裏表：07738_uraomote⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be two-faced — having a hidden side different from the public one
- うそつき: a liar — the plain word for someone who tells untruths
